title: Watch Pods For Failure
description: Watch pods in a live workload to see which one transitions from Running to Error first. The watch is BOUNDED via --request-timeout because `kubectl -w` never returns on its own.

workload_name.description: Prefix of the workload or job name.

watch_seconds.description: Bounded watch duration in seconds. `kubectl -w` streams indefinitely and the glue runner captures output to completion, so an unbounded watch hangs the run.
